When companies are willing to go public, it signals that conditions are supportive enough to raise capital in the equity markets – and that investors are receptive to new listings. articles.title: Japan and US agree to expand cooperation on missiles, military drills
articles.mainIdea: Japan and US agree to expand cooperation on missiles, military drills
articles.summary: AFP: Japan and US agree to expand cooperation on missiles, military drills. Tokyo and Washington agreed Friday to boost joint production of defence equipment including missiles, and expand their military presence in waters southwest of mainland Japan, as China ramps up pressure on its Asian neighbour.They agreed to further advance joint production of air-to-air missiles and surface-to-air interceptors.

articles.title: Thermo Fisher to shut Asheville plant
articles.mainIdea: Thermo Fisher to shut Asheville plant
articles.summary: The High Point Enterprise, N.C.: Thermo Fisher to shut Asheville plant. A global life sciences manufacturer with a presence in High Point plans to close its plant north of Asheville over the next two years, laying off more than 400 workers. In a Jan. 8 letter to the N.C. Department of Commerce and Asheville Mayor Esther Manheimer, Thermo Fisher Scientific said it expects 421 employees will lose their jobs as the company winds down its plant in Weaverville.
